pairs.source_text: SET DATEFIRST 7;                 -- Sunday = 1, so DayOfWeek is stable
targets: ALTER SESSION SET WEEK_START = 7;                 -- Sunday = 1, so DayOfWeek is stable

pairs.source_text: SELECT 1 FROM dbo.DimDate WHERE DateKey = CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), @d, 112))
targets:
SELECT 1 FROM
   <%salesdw%>.dbo.DimDate
WHERE
   DateKey = CAST(LEFT(TO_VARCHAR(:D, 'yyyymmdd'), 8) AS INT)

pairs.source_text:
INSERT dbo.DimDate (DateKey, [Date], [Year], [Quarter], [Month], MonthName, DayOfWeek, IsWeekend)
            VALUES (CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), @d, 112)),
                    @d,
                    YEAR(@d),
                    DATEPART(QUARTER, @d),
                    MONTH(@d),
                    DATENAME(MONTH, @d),
                    DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @d),
                    CASE WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @d) IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
targets:
INSERT INTO <%salesdw%>.dbo.DimDate (DateKey, Date, Year, Quarter, Month, MonthName, DayOfWeek, IsWeekend) VALUES (CAST(LEFT(TO_VARCHAR(:D, 'yyyymmdd'), 8) AS INT), :D, YEAR(:D :: TIMESTAMP), DATE_PART(QUARTER, :D :: TIMESTAMP), MONTH(:D :: TIMESTAMP), TO_CHAR(:D, 'MMMM'), <%AIM_DB%>.PUBLIC.DATE_PART_WEEK_DAY_UDF(:D),
                    CASE WHEN <%AIM_DB%>.PUBLIC.DATE_PART_WEEK_DAY_UDF(:D) IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

nodes.source_text:
WHILE @d <= @EndDate
    BEGIN
        IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.DimDate WHERE DateKey = CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), @d, 112)))
        BEGIN
            INSERT dbo.DimDate (DateKey, [Date], [Year], [Quarter], [Month], MonthName, DayOfWeek, IsWeekend)
            VALUES (CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(CHAR(8), @d, 112)),
                    @d,
                    YEAR(@d),
                    DATEPART(QUARTER, @d),
                    MONTH(@d),
                    DATENAME(MONTH, @d),
                    DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @d),
                    CASE WHEN DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @d) IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);
            SET @RowsAdded += 1;
        END;
        SET @d = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @d);
    END
